snippet.title: Goodnight Universe | Official Launch Trailer - Available NOW
snippet.description:
Goodnight Universe is the next game from the critically acclaimed independent game studio behind Before Your Eyes. 

Goodnight Universe is a game in which you are a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

Available now on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416100/Goodnight_Universe/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/goodnight-universe/9nt35fwnb5pc
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014923
Nintendo (NOA): https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/goodnight-universe-switch-2/
